crossRefs.note: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit…
But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely…
not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, to increase the guilt…
Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant…
Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.
Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the…
whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest…
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who…
One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at…
He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast…

translations.web: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
translations.bsb: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
translations.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
translations.asv: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,
